title: From a 2014 one-shot to a 2025 screen
lede: Release facts, the context of the 17-21 collection, and trivia. Each item is labeled: verified items are marked [FACT], unconfirmed ones [FAN THEORY].

facts.v: 藤本タツキ短編集「17-21」, Jump Comics+, October 4, 2021
Tatsuki Fujimoto Before Chainsaw Man: 17-21, VIZ Media, January 17, 2023
Episode 4 of Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26 (GRAPH77), Prime Video, November 2025

sections.title: What is 17-21?
body: In 2021, Shueisha released two collections of Fujimoto's short stories, titled after the author's age when he drew them: 17-21 and 22-26. Shikaku closes the first volume, after *A Couple Clucking Chickens Were Still Kickin' in the Schoolyard* (2011), *Sasaki Stopped a Bullet* (2013), and *Love is Blind* (2013).
VIZ Media published the English translation as *Tatsuki Fujimoto Before Chainsaw Man*. Volume 17-21 came out in January 2023, followed by 22-26 in April 2023.

sections.title: The anime adaptation
body: Eight stories from both collections were adapted into the anime anthology *Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26*. It had a limited run in Japanese theaters from October 17, 2025, then streamed globally and exclusively on Prime Video from early November 2025.

Shikaku is the fourth episode, animated by studio GRAPH77. Shikaku is voiced by Kana Hanazawa and Yugeru by Tomokazu Sugita. Avex Pictures released a separate trailer for each story, including Shikaku.

sections.title: Where Shikaku sits in Fujimoto's career
body: Reading 17-21 in order feels like watching someone find their voice. Shikaku, the last story in that volume, already holds much of what would become his signature: casually treated violence, an uncontrollable heroine, and an ending that turns suddenly tender.
Two years later Fujimoto began his first long series, *Fire Punch* (2016), which again plays with a body that keeps regenerating and suffering that cannot end.

trivia.text: The official title is written in katakana シカク, so its sound carries several kanji meanings at once.
The official anime site says Yugeru is bored after about 3,500 years of immortal life.
Shikaku is the only story in 17-21 centered entirely on a romance between a human and an immortal.
Some fans call Shikaku Fujimoto's official debut. Sources disagree about his debut order, so we do not state it as fact.
There is a theory that Shikaku is a 'prototype' of Power or Reze from Chainsaw Man. The resemblance is real, but there is no official statement about it.
The exact number of days or murder attempts is quoted differently all over the internet. We deliberately avoid stating a precise number.
